title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 3.67 (versions follow prime numbers; 367 after 359): the project's contact email is now diosyunalma@gmail.com. No code changes from 3.59. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v3.67: nuevo correo de contacto. Prototipo de investigación.
